details.label: Status
details.text: **first failure today** for `dsv4flash-fp4-1k1k-1p1d-dp8ep8-mtp`; passed the 6 most recent comparable completed scheduled runs (Jul 17–26). Single benchmark leg. details.text: `[LOW]` MoRI PD KV-transfer/completion-notification stall on the tail request (prefill holds 1 inflight req, decode `#running-req:0`); **disconfirming**: no MoRI/transfer error line in either server log, single occurrence — cannot yet rule out a rare tail-latency flake; no window commit proven to touch the MoRI transfer path.
